description: Run an app portfolio across Google Play and the App Store: vitals, reviews, earnings, releases.
name: io.github.sonlenef/storepilot-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google Cloud service account JSON key with Play Console access. Enables the Google Play tools.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS

environmentVariables.description: Play reports bucket id from Play Console -> Download reports -> Copy Cloud Storage URI. Required for installs, ratings and earnings.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_GOOGLE_REPORTS_BUCKET

environmentVariables.description: Path to the App Store Connect API .p8 private key. Enables the App Store tools.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_ASC_KEY_PATH

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API Key ID.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_ASC_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect API Issuer ID.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_ASC_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Vendor number from App Store Connect -> Payments and Financial Reports. Required only for sales reports.
environmentVariables.name: STOREPILOT_ASC_VENDOR_NUMBER
